units.text: Decades of changing smiles.A legacy that continues.

Neodent Dental Hospital was founded in Hyderabad in 1994 by Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman, opening its first practice in Mehdipatnam. In the decades since, that single clinic has grown into Neodent Dental Hospital, now practising across Mehdipatnam and Nampally, built on specialist-led dental care that has shaped every year since.
Dr. Md. Miftah Ur RahmanProsthodontist & ImplantologistAssistant Director · Neodent

Neodent was founded in 1994 in Mehdipatnam, Hyderabad, at a time when specialist-led dental care of this kind was still uncommon in the city. Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman established the practice around dentistry, prosthodontics and implantology, disciplines that would come to define Neodent's approach for the following three decades.

Rather than following a fixed template, Neodent's identity took shape gradually, through years of clinical practice: each technique adopted, each patient conversation had, each treatment carried out, added to a foundation the practice still stands on today. What started as a single clinic became, over time, a name associated in Hyderabad with careful, considered dental care.

For patients, that history is not an abstraction. An appointment in Mehdipatnam or Nampally today draws on more than three decades of accumulated clinical experience — treatment planning and judgement built consultation by consultation, and carried forward by the wider clinical team that now works alongside the practice's founder. Neodent has always centred on the person in the chair, not just the procedure ahead of them.

That continuity is what Neodent asks every patient to trust: a specialist-led clinical team, a clear explanation of every treatment option, and an approach that treats each visit — routine check-up or complex implant work alike — with the same attention it received in 1994.
A career built on specialist care.
Professor, Osmania Government Dental College & Hospital, Hyderabad
Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur RahmanFounder · Director · Neodent

Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman is the founder and director of Neodent Dental Hospital. He established the practice in Hyderabad in 1994 and has led its clinical direction for more than three decades, building Neodent around the disciplines of dentistry, prosthodontics and implantology.

A dental surgeon by training, with BDS and MDS (Chennai) qualifications and FCIP, his specialisation lies in prosthodontics and implantology — the reconstruction and replacement of teeth, and the surgical placement of dental implants. That specialist grounding has informed Neodent's clinical approach since its earliest years.

Alongside his clinical practice, Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman holds the position of Professor at Osmania Government Dental College & Hospital, Hyderabad, bringing an academic dimension to his work that complements decades of hands-on treatment. Teaching and clinical practice have run in parallel throughout his career, each informing the other.

With 30+ years of experience in dentistry, Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman's clinical philosophy has always placed the patient conversation ahead of the procedure — understanding the concern before proposing the treatment. That approach, established at Neodent's founding, continues to guide the practice today.
Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman & Dr. Md. Miftah Ur RahmanIn practice
Assistant Professor, SB Patil Dental College & Hospital

At Neodent, clinical experience is not held by one person alone. Dr. Md. Miftah Ur Rahman, Prosthodontist and Implantologist and Assistant Director at Neodent, works alongside Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman across both the Mehdipatnam and Nampally locations, extending the same specialist disciplines into the practice's day-to-day clinical work.

Alongside his role at Neodent, Dr. Md. Miftah Ur Rahman is an Assistant Professor at SB Patil Dental College & Hospital, echoing the academic dimension that has run through Neodent's clinical leadership since 1994. Together with the wider clinical team, this shared foundation of specialist training means no single appointment depends on one clinician's presence alone.
A history that can be seen.

Alongside its clinical work, Neodent has been covered by the Urdu press in Hyderabad, principally The Siasat Daily — coverage of professional lectures, dental health camps, orthodontic treatment and academic recognition within Neodent's clinical team.

These clippings are not curated for effect — they are simply what has been written about Neodent and its doctors over the years, kept as part of the practice's own record. Seen together, they trace a consistent thread: a Hyderabad dental practice that has stayed visible in its own community for as long as it has been treating patients.
Front-page dental care featureThe Siasat Daily · Mehdipatnam
Dental implant awareness campThe Siasat Daily · Nampally
Orthodontic treatment featureThe Siasat Daily · Nampally

Over the decades, Neodent and its clinical team have received a number of certificates, mementos and professional recognitions — from dental societies, academic institutions and community organisations. Rather than list them individually, Neodent lets the record speak for itself: a practice that has stayed engaged with its professional community for as long as it has been treating patients in Hyderabad.
Recognition ceremonyDr. Md. Miftah Ur Rahman
A legacy is built over time.The work continues.
A voice for better dental care.

Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman's work has not stayed confined to the treatment room. Over the years, he has taken part in dental education talks, television discussions and public awareness efforts aimed at helping ordinary patients understand their own oral health — from childhood dental care to the wider links between the mouth and general wellbeing.

These appearances sit alongside, rather than apart from, Neodent's clinical work: the same patient-focused approach that shapes a consultation in Mehdipatnam or Nampally also shapes how Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman talks about dental care in public — in plain, practical terms, rather than technical language.
A public conversation about dental care.

A presence in the wider community.

On the occasion of the 73rd Republic Day, Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman addressed a gathering at Government Dental College and Hospital, Hyderabad — a public appearance connected to the same institution where he has also held an academic teaching role.
Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman has also appeared in televised interviews discussing dental health with the public, extending his clinical voice beyond Neodent's own patients.

The same press coverage that documents Neodent's clinical history also records this public dimension of its work — lectures, health camps and media appearances that carried Neodent's name from the clinic into the wider community.
Republic Day addressGovt. Dental College & Hospital, Hyderabad
Dental awareness featureThe Siasat Daily · Nampally
Clinical team coverageThe Siasat Daily · Nampally

More than three decades after its founding, Neodent Dental Hospital continues to practise across two Hyderabad locations — Mehdipatnam, where the practice began, and Nampally. Both locations are led by the same clinical philosophy Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman established in 1994.

Day-to-day care is carried by the wider Neodent clinical team, working alongside Dr. Mohd. Siraj Ur Rahman and Dr. Md. Miftah Ur Rahman, with specialist-led, patient-focused care carried into every consultation.
